intent_en: To illustrate the significant income disparity between high-income and low-income households.
previous_intent: To illustrate income inequality in Indonesia by contrasting the high income of Dewi's family in the top tier with the low income of Putri's family in the bottom tier of the household distribution.
narration_support: Dewey's family is rich and belongs to the top 10 % of households in terms of income. Putri's family is not as fortunate.
chart_support: Bar chart displaying a descending series of bars representing income distribution, contrasting a tall bar for Dewi's Family with a short bar for Putri's Family above a map of Indonesia.
evidence_note: Narration contrasts a rich family (top bracket) with a less fortunate one (bottom bracket), while the chart visualizes this gap using bar heights for Dewi's (tall) and Putri's (short) families, set against an Indonesia map. Note: Narration says 'Dewey', chart says 'Dewi'.
